description: Cream opaque low-square-neck court gown, fitted bodice, elbow-length shaped sleeves, long skirt with layered front opening below knee, warm gold-brown geometric borders at neckline, front, sleeve ends and hem. Wide decorated belt with metal medallions and small hanging chain, brown-gold fringed wrap resting along the arms, small pendant, earrings and bracelet. Both hands together in front; decorated shoes visible beneath hem, one partly covered. No headgear, armor, weapon or text.
